Side-scrolling motocross

v1.3

Patch notes

v1.3 19 Nov 2026

  • Modes. A new MODES button: Time attack (medals on every track), Trick mode, a two-minute Freestyle arena, Elimination (last rider at each red gate is out), a 10-round Championship with a podium, Stunt challenges and a Track builder.
  • Ghosts. Race a see-through copy of your best run. Share it as a ghost code, and paste a friend’s code to race theirs.
  • Split times at every checkpoint, green when you’re ahead of your best run and red when you’re behind.
  • Flips. Lean all the way round in the air for a Backflip or Frontflip. Combine them with stunts for big points.
  • Holeshot. First rider into the first jump gets a little speed boost.
  • Pit board. A crew member at the side of the track shows your place and the gap.
  • Rain and night. Rain makes the track slippery and covers your bike in mud. Night races light the track with floodlights.
  • Crash camera. Big crashes play in slow motion up close.
  • Roost. Ride right behind someone and their back tyre throws dirt at you.
  • Photo finish for close races.
  • Garage. Pick your helmet, shirt, pants, bike colour and number. Earn coins by racing and spend them on engine, suspension and tyre upgrades (offline races only).
  • Rivals. Bolt, Viper and Blaze have their own riding styles, talk before the race, and remember who won last time.
  • Replay. Watch any race again with five camera angles and slow motion, mark a part and save it as a clip.
  • Settings. Lean assist for beginners, a two-stroke or four-stroke engine sound, weather, time of day, and more.
  • Your own tracks can be sand or mud, with up to 3 laps, and the ruts get deeper every lap.

v1.2 16 Nov 2026

  • 20 new tracks. 25 in all, from Sunset Valley to The Gauntlet, with six new places to race: sunset hills, snow, a beach, a night desert, a volcano and a swamp.
  • Stunts. Six of them: Superman, Heel Clicker, Can-Can and No-Hander in the air, Wheelie and Stoppie on the ground. Hold 1 to 6 (or press the buttons). Let go before you land: land a trick for points and a little speed boost, land in the middle of one and you bail.
  • Stunt bar. The keys for every stunt are shown at the bottom of the screen. Hide it with the ✕ button or H, bring it back with the STUNTS button or H.
  • Stunt points next to your time, and on the results screen.
  • New animations for every stunt, eased in and out so the rider moves smoothly.
  • Wheels fixed. At speed the spokes blur instead of strobing (looking like they stand still or spin backwards), and other riders' wheels now spin in online races.
  • Computer riders throw stunts on big jumps too, and sometimes bail.

v1.1 13 Nov 2026

  • Online races. Race up to 3 other people. Quick race puts you in a public room that starts by itself, or make a private room and share its code. Your name is your arcade account name.
  • New bike: MID 250. A mid-size bike with a stronger engine and a higher top speed than the STOCK 125. Pick it on the track screen or in the online lobby. The STOCK 125 is unchanged.
  • Speedometer. The dial from Poly Racer: revs, gear, speed and lights for gas, brake and air.
  • Bots make mistakes. Computer riders now over-rotate, freeze up in the air and fumble the throttle now and then, more often on Easy.
  • Patch notes, right here.

v1.0 11 Nov 2026

  • Five tracks, three computer riders, keyboard and touch.

Online

Race up to 4 people. Pick your bike in the lobby.

Lobby

    How to play

    Throttle Up / W · Brake Down / S · Lean back Left / A · Lean forward Right / D · Restart at checkpoint R · Pause Esc / P · Mute M

    On a phone or tablet: lean buttons bottom-left, brake and gas bottom-right. Hold several at once.

    Lean in the air to rotate. Match the angle of the landing slope to keep your speed; land badly and you'll lose it. Lean back on the ground to wheelie, lean forward to keep the front down.

    Stunts 1 Superman · 2 Heel Clicker · 3 Can-Can · 4 No-Hander (in the air) · 5 Wheelie · 6 Stoppie (on the ground). Hold the key; let go before you land or you'll bail. Landed tricks score points and give a small speed boost. H hides or shows the stunt bar.

    Flips Keep leaning back (or forward) in the air until you go all the way round, then land on your wheels for a Backflip (or Frontflip). Do a stunt in the same jump for a combo.

    Modes Time attack, Trick mode, the Freestyle arena, Elimination, the Championship, Stunt challenges and the Track builder are under MODES. Pick your gear and upgrades in the GARAGE, and turn on lean assist, ghosts, rain or night in SETTINGS. After a race, REPLAY shows it again from five cameras.

    Hit the ground with your head and you'll crash, then restart at the last checkpoint. Finish in the top 2 to unlock the next track.
